Penalty is broader concept which also is in the nature of punishment and serves as deterrence, it can be monetary and non-monetary.
Moreover, fine and penalty are involuntary in nature.
Fine/penalty proceeds on the premise that there has been violation or contravention of law and, therefore, one is required to pay fine or face penalty.
It is imposed as a consequence of violating rules or laws and there is no element of quid pro quo and unlike, fees, fines are not linked to any service or benefit.
Even in cases where the fees are regulatory in nature in the sense that they are involuntary, it is not imposed as penalty and the punitive element is absent.
